name: qa-resilience
description: Chaos engineering, fault injection, and resilience drills: 7 skills (chaos-experiment-author, chaos-mesh, toxiproxy-chaos, failure-injection-test-author, chaos-drill-protocol, dr-drill-runner, error-budget-tests). Experiment design with steady-state pre-flight validation and LitmusChaos/Gremlin routing via references, the chaos-drill run protocol with pre-flight gates, per-runner inject/abort commands, and recovery validation, Chaos Mesh, Toxiproxy, and combined HTTP+TCP fault injection, plus the full DR-drill discipline (runbook, supervised run protocol, backup-integrity verification, and restore-time / RTO measurement in references) and error-budget gating with burn-rate alerting and the MTTR / MTBF / MTTD / MTTA incident-metrics reference.
